description: Free x402 Lint by SpendPreflight. Includes a free passive Security Check summary; optional full report with fixes is $0.10, no automatic payment. Checks a public HTTPS endpoint with an unpaid GET: v1/v2 challenge shape, payTo/asset/network syntax, price, Bazaar metadata and browser CORS headers. Returns a heuristic Listing Guard riskScore (0–100 or unknown), fixes and a public seven-day report link. Positive scores include optional paid Listing Guard and monitoring links; no paid call is made. Scores are not safety or Bazaar acceptance guarantees. No payment or credentials; GET cannot validate a POST-only endpoint or paid delivery. Do not submit private URLs. CI Action: https://github.com/spendpreflight/x402-lint-action; report badge: /v1/lint/reports/{id}/badge.svg reads only the existing seven-day snapshot, never runs a check.
name: lint_endpoint
title: Free x402 Lint
